_note: Higgsfield Cloud endpoints (https://api.higgsfield.ai) verified against their published OpenAPI spec, 2026-09-18. `strengths`/`weak` drive alvion/router.py, which picks models so the user never sees a dropdown. Add models in Settings; the catalogue changes.

higgsfield-ai/soul/character.label: Soul Character
higgsfield-ai/soul/character.note: Holds one person's face and build across a whole campaign.

higgsfield-ai/soul/reference.label: Soul Reference
higgsfield-ai/soul/reference.note: Matches a supplied product or style reference closely.

higgsfield-ai/soul/standard.label: Soul
higgsfield-ai/soul/standard.note: General photoreal frames when there is no reference to match.

bytedance/seedream/v4/text-to-image.label: Seedream v4
bytedance/seedream/v4/text-to-image.note: Cheapest solid frame. Good for sets, B-roll and product-on-surface.

flux-pro/kontext/max/text-to-image.label: FLUX Pro Kontext Max
flux-pro/kontext/max/text-to-image.note: The one that renders legible type — labels, packaging, signage.

veo3.1/first-last-frame-to-video.label: Veo 3.1 — first + last frame
veo3.1/first-last-frame-to-video.note: The only model that accepts both a first and a last frame. Pinning the start frame as the end frame is what produces silent beats the edit can cut on.

veo3.1/image-to-video.label: Veo 3.1
veo3.1/image-to-video.note: Cinematic motion with dialogue generated inside the clip.

veo3.1/fast/image-to-video.label: Veo 3.1 Fast
veo3.1/fast/image-to-video.note: Half the cost of Veo 3.1, still with in-clip audio. Good for drafts.

kling-video/v2.5-turbo/pro/image-to-vide.label: Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro
kling-video/v2.5-turbo/pro/image-to-vide.note: Strongest at people: faces hold, body motion is natural, lip movement tracks. The default for avatar and UGC work.

kling-video/v2.1/master/image-to-video.label: Kling 2.1 Master
kling-video/v2.1/master/image-to-video.note: Follows a complex motion prompt more literally than Turbo.

bytedance/seedance/v1/pro/fast/image-to-.label: Seedance v1 Pro Fast
bytedance/seedance/v1/pro/fast/image-to-.note: Built for movement — dance, transitions, sweeping camera. Cheapest per second.

bytedance/seedance/v1/lite/image-to-vide.label: Seedance v1 Lite
bytedance/seedance/v1/lite/image-to-vide.note: Draft-tier motion. Use to test a plan before paying for the real thing.
